fr_claquer_verb.hook: CLACK! Monsieur Verbe SLAMS the chest lid shut (klah-KAY).
fr_claquer_verb.why: The sound CLACK → claquer = to slam, to bang. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_affairer_verb.hook: Broom, bucket, frying pan – Monsieur Verbe is BUSY with all his AFFAIRS (ah-feh-RAY); the hand mirror says s'affairer.
fr_affairer_verb.why: Affairs, busy-ness → s'affairer = to bustle about. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (s'). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_debarquer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe steps off the boat with his suitcase – he DISEMBARKS (day-bahr-KAY).
fr_debarquer_verb.why: Dis-embark → débarquer = to land, to get off a boat. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_atterrir_verb.hook: Down from the sky with his umbrella, Monsieur Verbe LANDS on TERRA firma (ah-tay-REER).
fr_atterrir_verb.why: Terre = ground → atterrir = to land. Regular -ir (nous atterrissons): GREEN beret.

fr_absorber_verb.hook: The paper towel ABSORBS the spilled juice (ahp-sor-BAY).
fr_absorber_verb.why: Absorb → absorber = to absorb, to soak up. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_tordre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe TWISTS the wet towel until it drips – TORsion (TORDR)!
fr_tordre_verb.why: Torsion, contort → tordre = to twist, to wring. Regular -re: PURPLE beret.

fr_inciter_verb.hook: 'Come on, in you go!' Monsieur Verbe ENCOURAGES the duckling – he INCITES it to swim (an-see-TAY).
fr_inciter_verb.why: Incite → inciter = to encourage, to prompt. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_basculer_verb.hook: Whoops! Monsieur Verbe's chair TIPS OVER backwards like a see-saw – a BASCULE (bahs-kew-LAY).
fr_basculer_verb.why: Bascule (see-saw) → basculer = to tip over, to topple. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_boucher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pushes the cork – the BOUCHON – into the bottle: he CORKS it up (boo-SHAY).
fr_boucher_verb.why: Un bouchon = a cork → boucher = to block, to cork, to stop up. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_plier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe FOLDS the towel neatly, PLY on PLY (plee-YAY).
fr_plier_verb.why: Ply (layers) → plier = to fold, to bend. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_peupler_verb.hook: Look – so many birds! The little island is full of PEOPLE: they POPULATE it (peuh-PLAY).
fr_peupler_verb.why: Peuple = people → peupler = to populate, to live in. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_ruer_verb.hook: Like the pony, Monsieur Verbe KICKS his heels up behind him – the pony RUES the day you stand behind it (RWAY)!
fr_ruer_verb.why: ruer = to kick out (horses, donkeys). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_destiner_verb.hook: The gift is for the dog: its DESTINATION is the kennel – it is DESTINED for him (days-tee-NAY).
fr_destiner_verb.why: Destiny, destination → destiner = to intend for, to destine. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_replier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe FOLDS the map back up – RE-PLY, fold again (ruh-plee-YAY).
fr_replier_verb.why: Re + plier → replier = to fold up, to fold back. Used here with an object (no se): Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_pincer_verb.hook: Ow! The crab PINCHES his finger with its PINCERS (pan-SAY).
fr_pincer_verb.why: Pincers → pincer = to pinch. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_rattacher_verb.hook: Click! Monsieur Verbe ATTACHES the lead AGAIN to the puppy's collar (rah-tah-SHAY).
fr_rattacher_verb.why: Re + attacher (attach) → rattacher = to tie back, to reattach. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_rejeter_verb.hook: No broccoli, thank you! Monsieur Verbe REJECTS the plate (ruhzh-TAY).
fr_rejeter_verb.why: Reject → rejeter = to reject, to throw back. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_crever_verb.hook: Pssst… Monsieur Verbe's bike tyre has a PUNCTURE – a CREVICE in the rubber (kruh-VAY).
fr_crever_verb.why: crever = to burst, to puncture; crever un pneu = to get a flat tyre. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_repousser_verb.hook: The hay bale rolls at him and Monsieur Verbe PUSHES it BACK (ruh-pou-SAY).
fr_repousser_verb.why: Re + pousser (push) → repousser = to push back; also to postpone. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_enchainer_verb.hook: Loop after loop, Monsieur Verbe LINKS them into a CHAIN (ahn-shay-NAY).
fr_enchainer_verb.why: Chaîne = chain → enchaîner = to link up, to follow one after another. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_pieger_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe sets a little box TRAP with a carrot – PIÈGE means trap (pyay-ZHAY).
fr_pieger_verb.why: Un piège = a trap → piéger = to trap, to catch out. Regular -er (je piège): RED beret.

fr_abattre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe gives the tower a push and KNOCKS it DOWN – BATTER it down (ah-BAHTR)!
fr_abattre_verb.why: A + battre (beat) → abattre = to knock down, to fell. Irregular like battre (j'abats): GOLD beret.

fr_faucher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe MOWS the long grass – FAUCHER, like a FOLK harvester (foh-SHAY).
fr_faucher_verb.why: faucher = to mow, to scythe (une faux = a scythe). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_hisser_verb.hook: Heave-ho! Monsieur Verbe HOISTS the flag up the pole – HISS goes the rope (ee-SAY).
fr_hisser_verb.why: Hoist → hisser = to hoist, to raise. Used here with an object (no se): Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_enfoncer_verb.hook: Tap, tap – Monsieur Verbe DRIVES the tent peg IN with FORCE (ahn-fohn-SAY).
fr_enfoncer_verb.why: En + force → enfoncer = to drive in, to push in. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_craquer_verb.hook: CRACK! The dry stick CRACKS under Monsieur Verbe's foot (krah-KAY).
fr_craquer_verb.why: Crack → craquer = to crack, to creak. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_charrier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe CARTS a heavy load of logs in his wheelbarrow – a CHARIOT of wood (shah-RYAY).
fr_charrier_verb.why: Chariot, cart → charrier = to cart, to haul (also, casually, to tease). Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il charrie du bois dans sa brouette.
He carts wood in his wheelbarrow.

fr_projeter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PROJECTS a picture of a ship onto the sheet (proh-zhuh-TAY).
fr_projeter_verb.why: Project → projeter = to project, to throw; also to plan. Regular -er (je projette): RED beret.

fr_enterrer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe BURIES the acorn IN the TERRA, the earth (ahn-tay-RAY).
fr_enterrer_verb.why: En + terre (earth) → enterrer = to bury. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_etendre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe hangs out the washing and EXTENDS each shirt along the line (ay-TAHNDR).
fr_etendre_verb.why: Extend → étendre = to spread out, to hang out (washing). Used here with an object (no s'). Regular -re: PURPLE beret.
